description: Glowmere at a sixth of its density: the floor of the renderer laboratory's ladder (docs/renderer-2-benchmark-world.md). Every density weight is the shipped glowmere recipe's multiplied by 0.40, which multiplies every layer's density by 0.16 and leaves the proportions between the species exactly as they were -- the same valley, the same air, the same light, thinned. Art direction, seed, extent, negative space and focal strength are identical to glowmere-medium, so the two are the same shot and differ only in how much grows in it.

certification.what: The floor of the density ladder: Glowmere thinned to a sixth. Not a regression subject on its own -- §6 of docs/renderer-2-benchmark-world.md measures its frame time moving 27% between two passes -- but its counters are exact and are worth pinning.
certification.declares: The counters below are what this rung submits at the resolution, tier and camera named here, and they are checked exactly by tools/certify.py. They can be: a composition is a pure function of (recipe, library, seed) and the culling decision a pure function of that plus the camera and the resolution, so an unequal count is a real change every time and carries no noise floor to argue about. The frame times are measured in the same run and are deliberately NOT declared -- a millisecond is a property of a session (01-audit-and-baseline.md §3.1), and a declared one would be a cross-session comparison with the other session hidden inside a constant.
